messages:
jess: Customer reported JSON mode parse failures after upgrade to v2. They say items in "events" array sometimes arrive as partial objects and sometimes with extra keys. Stack: hosted API, app using structured_output=json. Payloads sometimes parse fine, sometimes client throws: "Unexpected token". Repro attached.

sarah-cs: customer id CUST-982, affected env: prod US-west, started 2026-03-16 14:02 UTC. They saw increased 500s and billing errors (quote: "charge attempted but response invalid") :frowning: 

jess: Example request we sent (sanitized):
```
POST /v1/responses
{
  "model":"redwood-rlhf-1",
  "mode":"structured_json",
  "prompt":"extract events",
  "input":"...",
  "options": {"max_tokens": 800}
}
```
Response (sometimes):
```
200 OK
{
  "events": [
    {"type":"click","x":120},
    {"type":"purchase"},
    {"type":"view","x":90,"y":45}
  ]
}
```
but sometimes we get:
```
200 OK
{"events": [ {"type":"click","x":120}, {"type":"purchase","id": "ord_123", "unexpected":"foo"}, {"x":90,"y":45} ] }
```
client lib fails on missing "type" in 3rd item and extra "unexpected" key in 2nd -> parse exception.

amir-eng: Thanks, putting on my queue. Can you send exact request IDs from logs? Also is this with streaming on/off? Ordering assumptions can break if server flushes partial objects in stream. Have you tried `json_mode: permissive` fallback?

jess: request ids: r_20260316_14_02_11 (failed), r_20260316_14_03_04 (ok). Streaming was off. They use strict schema validation on client side.

tina-ml: Likely two separate issues: 1) model sometimes emits items missing required fields -> model/regression 2) post-processing occasionally concatenates partial tokens across array boundaries when output truncated/streamed. We'll repro with prompt that forces array output and schema.

jess: Customer also reported billing mismatch after failed parses: they saw a token charge but client dropped response and retried -> double-charge. @billing-bot any guidance?

billing-bot: Billing team: tokens are billed on completion of generation, but retries can cause extra billing if app re-sends request. Recommend support plan: manual credit for dup charge while root cause investigated. Tagging for approval.

infra-bot: Deployed inference node pool autoscale events at 14:01-14:04 UTC, CPU spiked, no throttles. No network errors logged. Correlation with partial outputs not definitive.

amir-eng: Next steps: 1) I'll run targeted eval vs redwood-rlhf-1 with strict schema prompts to try to reproduce missing "type" entries. 2) Add response post-parser tolerant check: if item missing "type" treat as NACK and trigger safe fallback to text mode. 3) Request CS to hold customer billing credits. I'll update in ~3h. @tina-ml please check model release notes around 2026-03-15 for any decoding/formatting tweaks.

sarah-cs: Sending customer timeline and logs now. Customer is blocked on ingestion pipeline. Please escalate if you need infra access :pray: 

jess: Thanks everyone. I'll add repro package and attach to this thread. :thumbsup:
